title: Democracies under pressure
discussion_signal: The post identifies disputed elections, weakened electoral authorities, and eroded checks and balances as internal pressures on democracy. Audience discussion adds implementation capacity and public trust as conditions determining whether formal reforms work in practice.
linked_research_question: How do institutional design, implementation capacity, and public trust interact when democratic systems come under internal pressure?
limits: Institutional report promotion and self-selected comments
The discussion does not represent all Latin American and Caribbean publics
No causal claim about specific reforms is established
